airspace.zh: 龜山島須事先向東北角及宜蘭海岸國家風景區管理處申請才能登島，島上另有不開放的管制區；官方登島規定未列出無人機專門條文。實際飛行前請用民航局「Drone Map」App 查詢並依規定申請。
airspace.en: Landing on Guishan Island requires prior application to the Northeast and Yilan Coast National Scenic Area Administration, and parts of the island are closed zones; the official landing rules contain no drone-specific clause. Before any real flight, check the Civil Aviation Administration "Drone Map" app and apply as required.

island.note: 火山島本體的中心點（維基百科條目座標）；拍龜首時鏡頭置於東側，拍龜尾時置於西側

summit_401.note: 全島最高點，天然標高398公尺；座標為史密森尼全球火山計畫登錄的火山位置，精度約100公尺

guiwei_lake.note: 龜尾的半鹹水湖（又稱龜池），普陀巖、舊聚落與碼頭都在湖區周邊；座標取自地名資料「Gui Chi」，精度有限，宜再以地圖核對

wushi_harbor.note: 頭城的漁港與遊艇港，清代曾是蘭陽第一大港，1991年重建

wushi_boarding.en: Wushi Harbor boarding point for Guishan Island
wushi_boarding.note: 登島與繞島船班的搭船處（管理處景點頁導航座標）

lanyang_museum.note: 烏石港舊址濕地旁的博物館，外形取自東北角的單面山

waiao.note: 正對龜山島的海灘與服務區，眺望龜山朝日的地點

beiguan.note: 清代關隘舊址，單面山與豆腐岩海岸，觀海平台可望龜山島

daxi_harbor.note: 鄰近龜山島漁場的漁港；1977年遷村的島民多落腳大溪

title.en: From Fishing Village to Ecological Park

tagline.zh-Hant: 十九世紀的移民、一九七七年的遷村與二〇〇〇年的重新開放
tagline.en: Settlers of the 1800s, the 1977 relocation and the reopening in 2000

zh: 宜蘭外海的龜山島，如今沒有常住居民。
一百多年間，這裡卻是一座漁村。
en: Guishan Island, off the Yilan coast, has no permanent residents today.
Yet for more than a century it was a fishing village.

zh: 清道光年間的文獻，已記載島上有人居住。
十九世紀中葉起，福建移民陸續在此落腳。
en: Qing records from the Daoguang era already mention people living here.
From the mid-1800s, settlers from Fujian made the island their home.

zh: 聚落集中在龜尾的湖畔。
石砌的屋舍覆著茅草，一間緊挨著一間。
en: The village clustered beside the lake at the turtle's tail.
Stone houses with thatched roofs stood packed closely together.

zh: 島民捕魚維生，也在山坡種地瓜與花生。
水泥房屋到一九五〇年代才出現。
en: Islanders fished for a living and grew sweet potatoes and peanuts on the slopes.
Concrete houses did not appear until the 1950s.

zh: 全盛時期，島上住了七百多人。
飲水靠山泉，夜裡多半點煤油燈。
en: At its peak, more than 700 people lived on the island.
Water came from springs, and most homes were lit by kerosene lamps.

zh: 湖邊曾有島上唯一的學校，龜山國小。
en: By the lake stood Guishan Elementary, the island's only school.

zh: 一九七四年颱風接連來襲，小島一度斷了補給。
同年，宜蘭縣政府提出遷村。
en: In 1974 a run of typhoons cut the island off, and supplies ran low.
That same year the Yilan County Government proposed relocating the residents.

zh: 一九七七年，全島居民遷往對岸的大溪。
新家名為仁澤新村，島嶼此後列為管制區。
en: In 1977 all the residents moved across the water to Daxi.
Their new home was Renze New Village; the island became a restricted zone.

zh: 遷村隔年，行政區「龜山里」遭到裁撤。
島民奔走多年，二〇〇一年終於復里。
en: A year after the move, Guishan Borough was abolished as an administrative unit.
After years of campaigning, the residents won it back in 2001.

zh: 一九九四年，宜蘭縣政府舉辦返鄉活動。
離島多年的居民，得以再次踏上故鄉。
en: In 1994 the county government organised a homecoming visit.
Islanders who had been away for years set foot on their home again.

zh: 出發的烏石港，曾是蘭陽第一大港。
一八七八年洪水帶來泥沙，舊港逐漸淤塞。
en: Wushi Harbor, the departure point, was once the largest port in Lanyang.
Silt from a flood in 1878 began to choke the old harbor.

zh: 港口在一九九一年重建。
如今登島的船班由這裡出發。
en: The harbor was rebuilt in 1991.
Boats to the island now leave from here.

zh: 一九九九年底，行政院同意有條件開放。
二〇〇〇年，龜山島正式開放觀光。
en: In late 1999 the Executive Yuan approved a partial reopening.
In 2000 the island formally opened to visitors.

zh: 同年，龜山島納入國家風景區，定位為海上生態公園。
開放之初，每天只收二百五十人。
en: That year it joined the national scenic area as a marine ecological park.
At first, only 250 visitors a day were admitted.

zh: 名額逐步放寬，目前每日上限一千八百人。
每週三保留給學校與學術單位。
en: The quota was raised in stages and now stands at 1,800 a day.
Wednesdays are reserved for schools and academic groups.

zh: 通往最高點的步道，共一千七百零六階。
每天限一百人，而且只在上午開放。
en: The trail to the highest point has 1,706 stone steps.
It is limited to 100 people a day, in the morning only.

zh: 二〇二四年康芮颱風重創設施，島嶼提前封閉。
隔年三月一日才重新開放。
en: Typhoon Kong-rey badly damaged facilities in 2024, and the island closed early.
It reopened on 1 March the following year.

zh: 百年漁村，如今只在開放季節迎接訪客。
對岸的大溪，仍有一個以龜山島為名的社區。
en: A village for a century, it now receives visitors only in season.
Across the water in Daxi, a community still carries the island's name.

tagline.zh-Hant: 宜蘭的精神地標、島民的媽祖與大溪的漁港
tagline.en: Yilan's landmark, the islanders' Mazu and the fishing harbor at Daxi

zh: 從宜蘭的海岸望出去，海上總有一座龜山島。
公共電視的報導稱它是宜蘭的精神地標。
en: From the Yilan coast, Guishan Island is always there on the sea.
Taiwan's Public Television Service has called it Yilan's spiritual landmark.

zh: 外澳的海灘正對著島嶼。
「龜山朝日」是龜山八景之一。
en: The beach at Wai'ao looks straight out at the island.
Sunrise over the island is one of the "Eight Views of Guishan".

zh: 沿著頭城海岸往北，島的輪廓不斷變化。
從大溪一帶看，東端像一顆龜頭。
en: Heading north along the Toucheng coast, the island's outline keeps changing.
Seen from around Daxi, its eastern end looks like a turtle's head.

zh: 換到羅東、五結的方向，它卻像個三角形。
這種變化，被稱為「龜山轉頭」。
en: From the direction of Luodong and Wujie it looks triangular instead.
The change is known as "the turtle turning its head".

zh: 山頂罩著雲時，人們說是「神龜戴帽」。
在地的說法是，這代表天氣要變壞了。
en: When cloud sits on the summit, people say the turtle is wearing a hat.
Local belief holds that bad weather is on the way.

zh: 登島與賞鯨的船，都從烏石港出發。
登島的遊客，都要有專業解說員陪同。
en: Boats for landing and for whale watching all leave from Wushi Harbor.
Visitors who land must be accompanied by a trained guide.

zh: 上岸後不遠，就是島上唯一的信仰中心。
它原名拱蘭宮，建於清光緒十七年。
en: Not far from the landing stands the island's only place of worship.
First called Gonglan Temple, it was built in 1891, in the Guangxu reign.

zh: 島民靠海維生，廟裡後來改奉媽祖。
遷村時，神像隨著居民渡海到大溪。
en: As the islanders lived from the sea, the temple came to enshrine Mazu.
When the village moved, her statue crossed to Daxi with the residents.

zh: 留在島上的廟，後來改奉觀世音菩薩。
一九九九年，廟名改為普陀巖。
en: The temple left on the island was later dedicated to Guanyin.
In 1999 it was renamed Putuoyan.

zh: 每年五月，島民後代會回島祭祖。
媽祖神像也一同回到原來的廟。
en: Every May, descendants of the islanders return to honour their ancestors.
The Mazu statue travels back with them to its original temple.

zh: 語言學者發現，島民的閩南語有自己的特色。
它保留了較多宜蘭腔的老特徵。
en: Linguists have found the islanders' Taiwanese Hokkien to be distinctive.
It keeps more of the older features of the Yilan accent.

zh: 島民幾乎全靠漁業維生。
離島後多數落腳大溪，也有人去了南方澳、花蓮與基隆。
en: Almost all the islanders made their living from fishing.
Most resettled in Daxi; others went to Nanfang'ao, Hualien and Keelung.

zh: 大溪漁港鄰近龜山島漁場，魚獲種類多。
下午兩三點漁船回港，魚貨就地喊價拍賣。
en: Daxi Fishing Harbor lies near the Guishan fishing grounds and lands a varied catch.
Boats return around two or three in the afternoon, and the fish are auctioned on the quay.

zh: 二〇〇五年，社區成立了漁村文化館。
館內展示早年島上的漁具與生活器物。
en: In 2005 the community opened a fishing-village culture hall.
It displays fishing gear and household objects from life on the island.

zh: 長輩用「打寸子」這類童玩，留住島上的記憶。
社區的門牌上，還印著龜山島的輪廓。
en: Elders keep island memories alive through old games such as "da cun zi".
House number plates in the community carry the outline of the island.

zh: 二〇一七年起，蘭陽博物館與文化館合作整理館藏。
長輩對著老物件說故事，剪成影片〈龜山島來的人〉。
en: From 2017 the Lanyang Museum worked with the culture hall to sort its collection.
Elders' stories about the old objects became a film, "People from Guishan Island".

zh: 火車穿出草嶺隧道，龜山島就出現在海上。
北關的觀海平台，也是眺望島嶼的地點。
en: As trains emerge from the Caoling Tunnel, the island appears out at sea.
The viewing platform at Beiguan is another place to look across to it.

zh: 島上已沒有居民，記憶仍在對岸延續。
龜山島依舊守在宜蘭的海平線上。
en: The island has no residents now, but its memory is kept alive across the water.
And the island still sits on Yilan's horizon.

title.en: Forest and Sea on a Volcanic Island

tagline.zh-Hant: 原生蒲葵林、島上的動物與熱泉邊的怪方蟹
tagline.en: Native fan palms, island wildlife and the crab of the hot vents

zh: 太平洋上的龜山島，每年冬季封島三個月。
東北季風帶來風浪，島上生態也趁此休養。
en: Guishan Island, in the Pacific, is closed for three months every winter.
The northeast monsoon brings rough seas, and the island's ecosystems get a rest.

zh: 山頂一帶仍是低海拔的原生森林。
島上可見姑婆芋、五節芒與相思樹。
en: Around the summit the slopes are still covered in native lowland forest.
Giant taro, silvergrass and Taiwan acacia grow on the island.

zh: 島上有一片原生的蒲葵林。
官方介紹它是全臺唯一天然生長的蒲葵林。
en: The island has a stand of native Chinese fan palms.
Official guides describe it as the only naturally growing one in Taiwan.

zh: 毛柿步道旁，有樹徑超過八十公分的老樹。
島民把這些毛柿視為神木。
en: Beside the Maoshi Trail stand old trees more than 80 cm across.
Islanders regard these ebony trees as sacred.

zh: 龜尾湖畔長著海檬果。
海岸一帶則有馬鞍藤與蔓荊。
en: Sea mango trees grow beside Guiwei Lake.
Beach morning glory and beach vitex grow along the shore.

zh: 四月下旬，島上的百合陸續開花。
島上的一草一木，都不能採摘帶走。
en: In the second half of April, the island's lilies come into bloom.
Nothing that grows here may be picked or taken away.

zh: 調查記錄到兩棲類三種、蜥蜴五種、蛇類六種。
登島須知提醒遊客留意毒蛇與蜂。
en: Surveys have recorded three amphibian, five lizard and six snake species.
Visitor rules warn people to watch for venomous snakes and bees.

zh: 鳥類有二十五種，其中十六種是留鳥。
蝴蝶則記錄到大約一百零四種。
en: Twenty-five bird species are listed, sixteen of them resident.
Around 104 species of butterfly have been recorded.

zh: 二〇二五年開島之際，島上種下毛柿、蒲葵和樹杞。
它們是保育類狐蝠的食源與棲息樹種。
en: Around the 2025 reopening, ebony, fan palm and Ardisia saplings were planted here.
They are food and roosting trees for the protected flying fox.

zh: 周邊海域淺，魚群聚集，是臺灣三大漁場之一。
這裡記錄過十七種以上的鯨豚。
en: The surrounding sea is shallow and full of fish, one of Taiwan's three major fishing grounds.
More than 17 species of whales and dolphins have been recorded here.

zh: 常見的是飛旋海豚、瓶鼻海豚、小虎鯨與偽虎鯨。
四月到九月下旬，是賞鯨豚的季節。
en: Spinner and bottlenose dolphins, pygmy killer whales and false killer whales are the regulars.
The watching season runs from April to late September.

zh: 龜首附近的海底，熱泉持續湧出。
泉口周圍住著烏龜怪方蟹。
en: On the seabed near the turtle's head, hot springs keep pouring out.
Around the vents lives a crab, Xenograpsus testudinatus.

zh: 二〇一六年地震與颱風引發崩塌，堵住許多泉口。
研究發現，泉口邊的生物挺過了水質劇變。
en: In 2016 an earthquake and a typhoon set off landslides that blocked many vents.
Studies found that vent-side species coped with the abrupt change in water chemistry.

zh: 陡峭的岩壁上，也有適應峭壁的植物。
周圍海域則記錄到大約六十種珊瑚。
en: Even the sheer rock faces carry plants adapted to cliffs.
In the surrounding waters about 60 species of coral have been recorded.

zh: 每年三月開島前，都要先淨灘。
二〇二五年的淨灘，清出將近三公噸垃圾。
en: Each March, before the island opens, the beach is cleaned.
The 2025 clean-up removed nearly three tonnes of rubbish.

zh: 漂上岸的垃圾裡，常見漁業浮球與塑膠桶。
遊客產生的垃圾，則全數隨船運回本島。
en: Fishing floats and plastic drums are common among what washes ashore.
Rubbish from visitors all goes back to the mainland by boat.

zh: 島上禁止狩獵、生火、餵食與放生。
未經許可，也不能攜入動植物。
en: Hunting, fires, feeding wildlife and releasing animals are all banned.
No animals or plants may be brought in without permission.

zh: 森林、礫灘、湖泊與熱泉，擠在不到三平方公里的島上。
管制登島人數，正是為了保護這裡的自然生態。
en: Forest, gravel beach, lake and hot vents share less than three square kilometres.
Visitor numbers are limited precisely to protect the island's natural ecology.

tagline.zh-Hant: 龜首、龜甲、龜尾，與海底的熱泉
tagline.en: Head, shell and tail of the turtle, and the hot vents beneath the sea

zh: 頭城海岸以東約十公里，一座火山島浮出海面。
它為什麼像烏龜，又為什麼還在冒煙？
en: About ten kilometres east of the Toucheng coast, a volcanic island rises from the sea.
Why does it look like a turtle, and why is it still steaming?

zh: 島嶼東西長約三點三公里，南北約一點七公里。
面積二點八五平方公里，海岸線約十公里。
en: The island is about 3.3 km from east to west and 1.7 km from north to south.
It covers 2.85 square kilometres, with roughly 10 km of coastline.

zh: 它是一座層狀火山露出海面的頂部。
岩石以安山岩質的熔岩流與火山碎屑為主。
en: What stands above the water is the top of a stratovolcano.
Its rock is mainly andesitic lava flows and volcanic debris.

zh: 這裡位在沖繩海槽的西南端。
海槽的尖端越過島嶼，延伸進蘭陽平原。
en: The island sits at the southwestern end of the Okinawa Trough.
The tip of the trough runs past it and on into the Lanyang Plain.

zh: 中央的龜甲是主體，最高點海拔三百九十八公尺。
加上山頂三公尺高的建物，得名四〇一高地。
en: The central "shell" is the main body, peaking at 398 metres.
A three-metre structure on top gives it the name 401 Highland.

zh: 龜甲原是一座圓錐形的火山。
南半部崩落入海，留下陡直的斷崖。
en: The shell was once a cone-shaped volcano.
Its southern half collapsed into the sea, leaving sheer cliffs.

zh: 北側與西北側，則是熔岩流形成的扇狀坡面。
en: To the north and northwest, lava flows left broad, fan-shaped slopes.

zh: 東端的龜首，是另一座橢圓形的火山錐。
岩質脆弱，颱風與地震時容易崩塌。
en: The "head" at the eastern end is a separate, oval volcanic cone.
Its rock is weak and prone to collapse in typhoons and earthquakes.

zh: 二〇一五年四月，龜首在地震後崩落一角。
二〇二四年四月三日的強震，岩壁再次崩塌。
en: In April 2015 part of the head fell away after a series of earthquakes.
The strong earthquake of 3 April 2024 brought down more of the cliff.

zh: 龜首周圍的海底，有數十個熱泉噴口。
它們位在水下五到三十公尺，水溫可達攝氏一百度左右。
en: On the seabed around the head are dozens of hydrothermal vents.
They lie 5 to 30 metres down, and the water emerges at around 100°C.

zh: 噴出的硫磺與氣泡，把海水染成乳白與淺藍。
這片海因此被稱為「牛奶海」。
en: Sulphur and gas bubbles from the vents turn the sea milky white and pale blue.
The patch of water is nicknamed the "Milky Sea".

zh: 龜首的岩縫間，硫氣孔仍在噴氣。
二〇二一年十一月，這裡曾冒出明顯的煙柱。
en: Fumaroles still vent from cracks in the rock of the head.
In November 2021 a conspicuous plume of gas rose here.

zh: 過去七千年，這座火山至少噴發過四次。
清代文獻與一八五三年的航海紀錄，都留下相關描述。
en: The volcano has erupted at least four times in the past 7,000 years.
Qing-era accounts and a ship's report from 1853 both describe activity here.

zh: 往西是低平的龜尾。
一道長約一公里的安山岩礫灘，伸向海中。
en: To the west lies the low, flat "tail".
A beach of andesite gravel about a kilometre long reaches out into the sea.

zh: 礫灘的位置，隨冬夏的風向南北擺動。
這就是八景裡的「靈龜擺尾」。
en: The gravel spit shifts north and south with the winter and summer winds.
This is the scene known as "the turtle wagging its tail".

zh: 礫灘圍住的龜尾湖，長約四百公尺、寬約二百公尺。
它原是淡水湖，引入海水後成了半鹹水湖。
en: Enclosed by the gravel, Guiwei Lake is about 400 m long and 200 m wide.
Once fresh water, it turned brackish after seawater was let in.

zh: 對岸的北關，海岸是單面山與豆腐岩地形。
烏石港以南，海岸則轉為沖積平原。
en: Across the water at Beiguan, the coast is one of cuestas and "tofu" rock.
South of Wushi Harbor the shore becomes alluvial plain.

zh: 龜首、龜甲與龜尾，分別是火山錐、崩塌的山體與礫灘。
海底的熱泉說明，這座火山仍在活動。
en: Head, shell and tail are, in turn, a volcanic cone, a collapsed mountain and a gravel spit.
The vents on the seabed show that this volcano is still active.
